cues: Third, the period is inversely proportional to root g, so a pendulum runs slower on the Moon.
And fourth, for small swings, the period does not depend on the amplitude.
That is isochronism, the property that made pendulum clocks possible.
A seconds pendulum has a period of exactly two seconds, one second each way.
